sentences.Jeg har en gave til deg. Vær så god!: I have a present for you. Here you are!
Oh! A box of chocolates. Thank you very much.
sentences.Der sitter to fra norskkurset, men hvem: There are two people from the Norwegian course sitting over there, but who are they?
Oh yes, that's Nelson. He's a good friend.
We call him Nelson, but his name is Thomas.
Thomas is nice. Now he's coming over here.
Hi, Irina. Nice to meet you.
sentences.Jeg mener: Jobber du eller studerer du?: I mean: do you work or do you study?
sentences.Irina er på fest hos Pablo, og han får e: Irina is at a party at Pablo's, and he gets a box of chocolates from her.
sentences.Irina snakker med Thomas, en venn av Pab: Irina talks to Thomas, a friend of Pablo's.
